thread:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up — new interviewer onboarding is assigning the wrong scorecard template for Backend role. Webhook sends department=backend-engineering but our router expects 'backend', so generic scorecard gets applied. Also training_badge sync is failing because role tags don't match.
Noah Park: Which webhook source is this? vendor or internal?
Aisha Khan: It's the new vendor feed 'hirefast'. Sample payload: ```{"email":"toni@example.com","role":"Backend Engineer","department":"backend-engineering","tags":["interviewer","newhire"]}```
Samir Patel: I see the problem. Our scorecard-routing lambda checks `department === 'backend'` and `role_slug === 'backend_engineer'` — vendor uses hyphenated/decorated strings. I'll update routing to normalize (lowercase, strip suffixes like '-engineering', replace spaces/characters).
Maya Rodriguez: This impacted ~42 interviews so far; candidates got the generic Product rubric. Several hiring managers noticed mismatched questions.
Noah Park: Can we backfill the correct scorecards for affected interviews? Need list of interviews and interviewer IDs.
Samir Patel: Running backfill query: ```SELECT i.id, i.candidate_email, i.interviewer_id, i.scorecard_id FROM interviews i WHERE created_at>='2026-05-01' AND i.scorecard_id='generic' AND i.interviewer_source='onboard-webhook';``` Est rows: 42.
Recruiting Bot: :warning: 42 interviews matched backfill query.
Maya Rodriguez: Plan: 1) Deploy router normalization patch. 2) Run idempotent backfill to assign the correct scorecard. 3) Re-run training_badge sync for those interviewers. 4) Add vendor schema sample to onboarding docs and a CI check.
Noah Park: I'm pausing new interviewer automations and live scheduling until backfill completes.
Samir Patel: PR opened with normalizeDepartment/Role() util and a small mapping table for legacy vendor tags. Also added an integration test that feeds the sample payload. Backfill job is ready — it will map interviewer->correct_scorecard and send assignment notice if different.
Aisha Khan: We should notify interviewers about reassignments. Maya can draft the message.
Maya Rodriguez: Draft in #people-ops-drafts: "Hi <interviewer> — we updated the scorecard for interviews you're scheduled for to better match the role. No action needed unless you'd like to keep the prior template. Reply here to opt out." Sending after legal review.
Noah Park: After backfill, run training_badge sync: ```POST /internal/training/sync-badges {interviewer_ids: [..]} ```
Samir Patel: Sync result: 200 OK for 38/42 accounts; 4 missing external_training_id in HR profile. I'll file reconciliation tickets for those four.
Aisha Khan: Retro items: 1) require a vendor schema contract + sample CSV/JSON on onboarding; 2) add e2e test for scorecard routing; 3) surface mapping warnings in Deploy/Console. Assignments: Samir - router patch + backfill + tests; Noah - pause/verify + scheduler snapshot; Maya - comms; Aisha - vendor escalation. Blocking on legal review for comms. :thumbsup:
